academic_habitability_proxy.meaning: External wheelbase-by-BODY-width envelope per nominal place, NOT measured interior area or comfort.
academic_habitability_proxy.input_policy: Positive observed exact-variant or explicitly qualified model-nominal geometry; no imputation; preserve all citations, applicability and limitations.
academic_habitability_proxy.justification: Transparent dimensional exploratory normalization. 1 square metre per nominal place is an arithmetic reference, NOT a calibrated comfort threshold. No readiness cutoff uses this utility.
academic_habitability_proxy.weight_source: Unmodified v3 passenger_space weight (0.25); exploratory assumption, not empirically validated.
academic_habitability_proxy.confidence: Uncalibrated weak geometric surrogate; numeric confidence remains null.
limitations: Penalizes nominal capacity, including seven-seat layouts
Ignores packaging, row distribution, headroom and usable legroom
Does not certify ride-hailing platform eligibility

safety.path_a: Complete exact observed airbags/ABS/ESC inventory with unchanged v3 equipment index.
safety.path_b: Reviewed exact official Latin NCAP test applicability; verified offline document hashes; explicit generation, body, configuration, year period and protocol.
safety.path_b_utility: 100 * official_result / official_maximum, only within the same protocol, metric and scale; NOT equipment inventory or injury probability.

ranking.grouping: Profile + evidence path + protocol/metric/maximum + available positive-weight criteria. No pooled ranking across incompatible evidence.
ranking.ties: Exact quantized score ties; ID only stabilizes display; include all boundary ties in top10 metrics.
ranking.coverage: Available original positive weights / all original positive weights; never statistical confidence or a score multiplier.
ranking.readiness: Exact identity, original eligibility gates, all required criteria/required_any and complete academic scenario TCO. Alternative evidence is accepted ONLY by academic_test_ready.

sensitivity.purpose: Prespecified one-at-a-time perturbations, not calibrated to counts or order. Undivided envelope is a separate m2 specification, not measured space.
